tagline: Docker update monitoring, policies, backups and restore for ZimaOS
description:
Self-hosted Docker update dashboard for ZimaOS with image and version checks,
per-app update policies, targeted verification, update installation, backup
and restore workflows, and runtime information.

When Update Monitor updates itself, an open browser page detects the new
backend version and reloads automatically with cache busting.

**Before installation:** Use **Custom install → Advanced (show more)** and
replace all security placeholders before the first start. Set your own
`UPDATE_MONITOR_USERNAME`, choose an `UPDATE_MONITOR_PASSWORD` with at least
12 characters, and generate a unique `UPDATE_MONITOR_SESSION_SECRET` with
at least 32 characters. Do not install the app with unchanged
`CHANGE_ME_...` values.

`UPDATE_MONITOR_GITHUB_TOKEN` is optional. Leave it empty if you do not
want to use a GitHub token.
